parts.name: body shell

physics.Basic_description: The main rectangular housing of the lock, colored bright orange with a smooth matte plastic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Encases the internal locking mechanism and provides the structural body for the device.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the sides of the orange body firmly with parallel jaws to stabilize the object.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic housing typically has thin walls enclosing an empty cavity for mechanisms.

parts.description: The main rectangular housing of the lock, colored bright orange with a smooth matte plastic finish.
parts.function: Encases the internal locking mechanism and provides the structural body for the device.

parts.name: keyway disc

physics.Basic_description: A small circular silver metallic disc located on the front face of the orange body.
physics.Functional_description: Serves as the interface for inserting a key to operate the lock cylinder.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and flush to grasp effectively; avoid contacting this area during manipulation.
physics.reason: Lock cylinders and faceplates are typically solid metal components for security and durability.

parts.description: A small circular silver metallic disc located on the front face of the orange body.
parts.function: Serves as the interface for inserting a key to operate the lock cylinder.

parts.name: keyway slot

physics.Basic_description: The dark vertical slot in the center of the keyway disc where the key enters.
physics.Functional_description: The physical aperture that accepts the key blade to engage the locking pins.
physics.Grasped_description: Not graspable; it is a negative space feature within the keyway disc.
physics.reason: Part of the solid metal lock cylinder assembly.

parts.description: The dark vertical slot in the center of the keyway disc where the key enters.
parts.function: The physical aperture that accepts the key blade to engage the locking pins.

parts.name: hinge bracket

physics.Basic_description: Small metallic strips or brackets visible near the bottom edge of the body in the side view.
physics.Functional_description: Likely serves as a pivot point or attachment hardware for the dust cover flaps.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to grasp; ignore during manipulation.
physics.reason: Hardware brackets are typically solid stamped or machined metal.

parts.description: Small metallic strips or brackets visible near the bottom edge of the body in the side view.
parts.function: Likely serves as a pivot point or attachment hardware for the dust cover flaps.

parts.name: shackle bar

physics.Basic_description: A white, U-shaped bar extending from the top of the orange body, appearing to be plastic.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the locking loop or handle that secures the equipment or allows carrying.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the horizontal section of the white bar with parallel jaws to lift or manipulate the lock.
physics.reason: Given the small scale and plastic appearance, it is likely a solid molded rod rather than a hollow tube.

parts.description: A white, U-shaped bar extending from the top of the orange body, appearing to be plastic.
parts.function: Acts as the locking loop or handle that secures the equipment or allows carrying.

parts.name: cover flap

physics.Basic_description: Two small orange tabs hanging from the bottom of the body, matching the body color.
physics.Functional_description: Protective flaps that cover the keyway or mounting points when not in use.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be pinched gently to flip open, but too small for primary support grasping.
physics.reason: Small molded plastic tabs are typically solid throughout their thickness.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF inertials where recorded; missing link inertials use MuJoCo geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
